001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.provider;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.spi.ScopedKeyValuesProvider;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.spi.ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactory;
005import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
006
007/**
008 * The {@code java.util.ServiceLoader}-discovered factory for
009 * {@link ScopedKeyValuesProviderImpl}.
010 */
011@ServiceProvider(ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactory.class)
012public final class ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactoryImpl implements ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactory {
013
014        /**
015         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
016         */
017        public ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactoryImpl() {
018        }
019
020        @Override
021        public ScopedKeyValuesProvider provide() {
022                return new ScopedKeyValuesProviderImpl();
023        }
024
025}
